    StartersDagobah swamp dipBaked spinach, artichoke and cream cheese dip with corn chipsHow to make it250g spinach280g marinated artichokes, chopped (1 jar)250g cream cheese100g sour cream50g parmesan, grated100g mozzarella, grated1 bag corn chipsWilt the spinach, squeeze dry and chop.Mix with the artichokes, cream cheese, sour cream and parmesan.Spread in a dish and top with mozzarella.Bake at 190°C until bubbling and golden. Serve with corn chips.Tauntaun beef and stout piesThe beast Han rides out into the Hoth blizzardHow to make itAs written, serves 4Flaky hand pies packed with chuck braised in stout with mushrooms and thyme, baked golden and served with a sharp horseradish and mustard dip.Brown 600g diced chuck in batches, add 1 diced onion and 200g sliced mushrooms, then 1 tbsp flour, 330ml stout, 200ml beef stock and thyme.Cover and simmer 2 hours until thick and tender, then cool.Cut 8 rounds from 4 sheets shortcrust for bases and 8 lids from 2 sheets puff.Fill, seal, brush with egg and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.Mix 100g sour cream with 2 tsp horseradish and 1 tsp Dijon.Charred root vegetables with herb oilWars not make one great.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsYoda's rootleaf stewParsnip, carrot, swede, celeriac and potato stew with miso, crusty breadHow to make it1 onion, diced2 tbsp olive oil2 parsnips2 carrots1/2 swede1/2 celeriac2 potatoes1.3 L vegetable stock3 sprigs of thyme1 bay leaf1 tbsp miso paste1 small bunch parsley1 crusty loafCut the parsnips, carrots, swede, celeriac and potatoes into chunks.Soften the onion in the oil.Add the vegetables, stock, thyme and bay leaf and simmer until tender.Stir in the miso, scatter with parsley and serve with the crusty loaf.Cloud City beef WellingtonA fancy dinner table, with Vader waiting at the end of itHow to make itAs written, serves 4Seared eye fillet wrapped in mushroom duxelles, prosciutto and golden puff pastry, carved pink with red wine jus and buttery mash.Season a 1kg eye fillet, sear all over and brush with Dijon.Cook 400g finely chopped mushrooms with 2 shallots and thyme until dry.Lay 8 slices prosciutto on cling film, spread with the mushrooms, roll the beef up tight and chill 20 minutes.Wrap in 2 sheets puff pastry, brush with egg and chill 20 minutes.Bake at 220°C for 25 minutes until 52°C inside and rest 10 minutes.Reduce 200ml red wine with 300ml beef stock for jus.Serve
